::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
MediaTek's India centre contributes to Dimensity mobile SoC and connectivity chip design. India is a growing design hub for the Taiwanese chipmaker. MediaTek opened a second 1.04 lakh sq ft R&D centre at BPTP Capital City, Sector 94, Noida, on a 10-year lease worth about Rs 144 crore (reported 2026-05-11).
:::

## What does this firm design?

Dimensity mobile SoCs, Wi-Fi 7 chipsets, smart TV and streaming media SoCs, and AI processing units for mobile.

**Why these scores**

- **Domain difficulty 4/5:** Mobile SoCs and Wi-Fi/cellular connectivity.
- **Strategic depth 3/5:** Contributes to Dimensity and connectivity design; product ownership remains in Taiwan.
- **Design completeness 4/5:** Bengaluru (2014) focuses on wireless communications; Noida on chip design; block-to-subsystem contributions.
- **India scale 2/5:** Over 1,000 engineers across Noida and Bengaluru (2024 reporting).
